data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Gōs,' meaning 'god.' The name Gow symbolizes a divine gift from the heavens. In the Bible, the name is associated with the prophet Gideon, who was chosen by God to save Israel from the Midianites. The name Gow carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gow usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
